metricDefinitions.firstEffectiveOperation: accepted public command index before the first accepted investigation action
metricDefinitions.firstAnsweredQuestionOperation: accepted public command index before the first question_answered event
metricDefinitions.averageValidQuestionRate: answered question events divided by question attempts
metricDefinitions.proofSetOverlap: pairwise evidence-set Jaccard; null when only one certified set exists
metricDefinitions.boardOperationEntropy: normalized entropy of public reasoning-board command types
metricDefinitions.replayBeatDensity: proof replay beat count divided by authored event count

qualification: 这些是叙事结构、节奏和交互风险代理指标；它们不能证明真人乐趣、审美、理解率、留存或市场适配。
